newsitem.title: CANADA: Fortis power unit wins one pct rate rise.
newsitem.headline: Fortis power unit wins one pct rate rise.

text.p: Newfoundland Power, the principal subsidiary of Fortis Inc, said Friday it had been awarded an average rate increase of approximately one percent by the Public Utilities Board of Newfoundland.
The new rate will take effect on January 1, 1997 and is based on a return of 11 percent on common equity in 1996 and 1997 - the mid-point of the approved range of 10.75 to 11.25 percent.
The company had asked the board for an average rate increase of 2.92 percent effective November 1, 1996, based on an allowed rate of return of 12 percent in a range of 11.75 percent to 12.25 percent.
